name: Ai-chan for Me Alpha ~Ai to Reijuu no Maid~
original_name: あいちゃん for Me α ～アイと隷従のメイド～
source:
The hero receives an invitation to the house of an old school friend. When he arrives, he is given his choice of four girls (named Ai, Ai, Ai, and Eileen) to be his maid! Will he fall in love with her, or simply use her as a slave?

[translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=449065]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角應一位老同學之邀，到對方家裡作客。才剛抵達，他就得到一個選女僕的機會。四個女孩分別叫作愛、藍、亞衣和艾琳！他會愛上自己選中的女僕，還是隻把她當奴隸使喚？

[譯自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=449065]Getchu[/url]]
